# TopologicalEdgeConfinement

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The physical mechanism of spatially restricting edge states without breaking the topological protection, using engineered potentials or lattice deformations. Allows precise placement of topological channels within a network, enabling scalable interconnectivity and routing in TCC-based computing fabrics.
